summary: NovaBridge Biosciences filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release that the FDA granted Fast Track Designation to givastomig, a CLDN18.2 x 4-1BB bispecific antibody, in combination with nivolumab and chemotherapy for first-line HER2-negative metastatic gastric cancer. No deal terms, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is described. This is a routine regulatory milestone disclosure for a drug development program, not a special situation event. The filing does not involve any corporate transaction or structural change that would qualify under any special-situation category.
